page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned with 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores built on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The architecture utilizes two threads per core and operates under a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 48.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include CPU instruction extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AES encryption acceleration. Network connectivity features an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance does not include bundled local storage or dedicated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark measurements indicate a hardware profile characterized by average multi-threaded throughput contrasted with lower single-core execution speed. Single-core performance tests like stress-ng single-core (1313.3) and single-threaded gzip compression (22.86 GB/sec) fall within the bottom 25% performance tier. Multi-core operations perform within the middle 50% category, demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 21007.3, a Geekbench multi-core rating of 8967.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 21643.62. Memory throughput for uncached large blocks registers at 108.94 GB/sec for reads and 47.99 GB/sec for writes.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation delivers qualitative resource efficiency for compute-heavy parallel workloads that do not require high memory density per core. Synthetic application benchmarks demonstrate stable middle-tier operational capacity, including 20.09 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 15.86 GB/sec. Suitable workload applications for ecs.c6.6xlarge include multi-threaded batch processing, software compilation, static web serving, and database management operations.
